model_weights: EXL3 2.9 bits/weight; native FP4 sparse indexer
topology: Two DGX Sparks, TP2, dual RDMA rails

screen.scope: Hardware counters at all three contexts; unprofiled prefetch ablation at 2K and 64K prose

continuation.scope: Same frozen binaries; loopback-only R115 near-1M retry, B350 and A2 across seven fixtures. Source outcomes retained independently.

pacing-interrupted.scope: Interrupted unprofiled A1/B115 run. B115 near-1M warmup rejected for overlapping external inference. B60/A2 were not started; raw failure and restoration retained.

precision_scope: No GPU arithmetic kernels or checkpoint weights changed in these experiments
timing_scope: Profiled range durations are diagnostic only; throughput comparisons have CUPTI and CPU trace disabled
accuracy_scope: Frozen greedy outputs, temperature 0, seed 1234, ignore EOS; not a broad task-accuracy evaluation
counter_scope: Target verification plus DSpark tap absorption; excludes full drafter pass, argmax/readback and prefill
counter_limit: Measured system-memory fills into L2, not total physical DRAM reads plus writes
public_identity_policy: Private host addresses, usernames, home/workspace paths and GPU UUIDs replaced with role labels; token arrays and numeric observations preserved

post_benchmark_source.changes: Collector abort handling and active-window probe; partial-window/gzip/settings validation; explicit continuation composition and invalid-metric rejection
post_benchmark_source.benchmark_scope: These later failure-handling and analysis changes were not used for the speed/counter matrices. Their validation is recorded separately.
